title: IAS 12, IAS 16 and IAS 36: Deferred taxes, depreciation and impairment of assets
core_idea: Analyze the interaction between IAS 12 (deferred taxes), IAS 16 (depreciation and amortization) and IAS 36 (impairment of assets) and assess their impact on financial statement presentation and corporate tax planning using a quantitative, non-experimental explanatory design based on PLS-SEM applied to accounting data from 50 SMV-listed asset-intensive companies (2022–2024).
tldr: Examines how depreciation/amortization, impairment and deferred tax accounting interact and affect financial reporting and tax planning using PLS-SEM on 50 asset-intensive firms' data.
